Energy

Summary of who wasted the most energy and who cost the enemy the most energy.
Calculated by adding up Losses (and Stalemates, Defends, Escapes, Interrupts) and Defends, the multiplying the number by 25.
E_Wasted means the member spent X energy on attacks that failed.
E_Stolen means X energy was wasted by the enemy on attacking the member unsuccessfully.
You might want to take a closer look at members with high E_Wasted values and remind them to pick fights they can win!

1 These numbers will be 0 if you are using an API key WITHOUT faction access.

Here is a summary of the provided combat data:

Overall Faction Performance

The faction shows a mixed performance overall. A good proportion of members participated in the war, indicated by a number of non-zero war hits. There are also a number of members with positive Net_Scores.

Areas for Improvement

  • E_Wasted Reduction: A significant opportunity for improvement lies in reducing wasted energy (E_Wasted).
  • Hospital Visits: While not of major concern, the total number of hospital visits could be lower, especially if it correlates with negative Net_Scores.

Individual Highlights: Positive

  • EYJL: High War_Hits (76), decent Assists (2), and a very high Net_Score (318.13) indicate strong offensive capabilities and contribution to the war effort.
  • Merle-DicksIn: High War_Hits (82) with a high Net_Score (326.07), is a significant contributor.
  • ThePickles: Significant Activity (8.422 hours), a high number of Total_Hits (91), and a very high Net_Score (471.72). This member demonstrated high engagement and effectiveness.
  • RipleyWolf: Exceptionally high Activity (20.399 hours) and a very high Net_Score (430.07), suggesting a very active and impactful participation.

Individual Highlights: Negative

  • SomeBOT: Zero War_Hits and a negative Net_Score (-135.29) indicates a lack of participation and a negative impact during the war.
  • MirandaWarning: Zero War_Hits and a negative Net_Score (-90.25) suggests a lack of engagement.
  • NatsuSensei: High Hospital visits (32) and a negative Net_Score (-98.35), is not an effective participant.
  • Goose_wayne: Net_Score of -121.64.
  • JaxieBear: Net_Score of -144.84.

Additional Observations

  • Resource Usage: The usage of boosters, cans, and refills is generally low across the faction.
  • FairFight: FairFight values appear to be within an acceptable range for most members, with a few exceptions.
  • Activity: Activity varies greatly among members, with some showing very high levels of engagement and others being almost completely inactive.
